Two internal and two external microphones work in tandem to detect outside noise, such as planes and car engines, and reduce up to 90% of it.
Oversized 40mm dynamic drivers with BassUp technology produce detailed sound and thumping beats, and support Hi-Res certified audio over the AUX cable.
40 hours of battery life with ANC on and 60 hours in normal mode let you commute in peace, and a 5-minute charge adds 4 hours of playtime.
Bluetooth 5.0 connects to two devices at once and switches between them instantly, so sound always comes from the device you need to hear.
The soundcore app lets you tailor your sound with 22 EQ presets or your own settings, switch between ANC, Normal and Transparency modes, and relax with white noise.
Switch to Transparency mode when you need to hear transport announcements, traffic or the people around you.
